descriptionChirho: An adjective or substantive denoting the left side, left hand, or leftward direction, as opposed to the right (יָמִין). All 9 occurrences refer to the same spatial orientation, whether used attributively ('the left [pillar/side]') or prepositionally ('on the left'). The distinction between the adjectival use with the article (הַשְּׂמָאלִית / הַשְּׂמָאלִי) and the prepositional construction (מִן הַשְּׂמֹאל) is syntactic, not semantic. Multilingual evidence: eng 'the left / on the left,' spa 'la izquierda / a la izquierda,' hin हश्शमालीत / से बाएँ, arb الْيُسْرَى / عَنِ الشِّمَالِ, kor 왼쪽의 / 에서 그 왼쪽, swa wa kushoto / upande wa kushoto.
